retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring subjects in formal white attire against a dense, patterned tapestry and ornate furniture.

recipe.visualDefinition: Two women in pale satin gowns and feathers seated on a blue damask settee, positioned against a busy floral tapestry. The lighting is harsh front-flash, creating deep shadows and high highlights on the fabric. A distinct rectangular gold box in the upper right corner contains centered serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the cool blue/white subjects and the warm, busy background tapestry
Symmetrical seating arrangement on a central ornate settee
Text box anchored to the top-right corner as a formal graphic element
Repetition of white textures through satin, pearls, and feathers
coreInvariants: Dense floral or pictorial tapestry background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-length figures centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white dresses against the dark, detailed background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the faces, move down the vertical lines of the dresses, and finish at the text box in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with pattern and texture.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale blue (subjects and furniture)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between subjects and background; low saturation in the foreground garments.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones for background and icy tones for foreground

letterConstructionRules: Small caps or all-caps for emphasis

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a gold rectangular frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of all-caps serif for primary titles with small-scale italics for connecting words.
graphicDevices: Solid color background for text container

candidateDirections.reason: Classic transitional serif with high legibility and formal tone.
High contrast strokes match the high-fashion editorial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of two women in white satin gowns and feather boas sitting on a blue rococo settee against a dark floral tapestry background using harsh flash photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a gold rectangular box with a thin double border in the top right corner. Inside the box, center-align three lines of serif text in dark brown.

verificationChecks: Is the text box in the top right corner?
Is the background a dense tapestry?
Are the dresses high-sheen white satin?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific band name or album title
Ensure the tapestry pattern is a generic floral/pastoral scene

mustAchieve: Clear separation between bright subjects and dark background
Clean, centered typography within the box

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast shadows on the subjects
Verify the gold box has a distinct border
Ensure the tapestry covers the entire background
Confirm the serif font is sharp and legible
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait of [Subject] in [White Formal Wear] on [Ornate Furniture] + [Tapestry Backdrop] + [Harsh Flash Lighting] + [Upper Right Gold Text Box with Serif Font]
